Title: Home page loads within 3 seconds
Preconditions: 1. Chrome is open on the MacBook Air, connected to home Wi-Fi.
Steps: 1. Press Cmd + Option + I to open Developer Tools. 2. Click the Network tab. 3. Tick Disable cache. 4. Go to https://automationexercise.com and press Cmd + R to reload. 5. When loading finishes, read the Load time at the bottom of the Network tab. 6. Repeat steps 4–5 two more times and record all three times.
Expected Result: The Load time is 3 seconds or less in each attempt.
Comments: Single-user page load check only, not load testing (see Out of Scope in the Test Plan). Ads and network speed can affect results, so record all three times.

Title: Signup / Login page uses a secure HTTPS connection
Preconditions: 1. The user is logged out. 2. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Steps: 1. Click Signup / Login in the header. 2. Click the icon to the left of the web address in Chrome.
Expected Result: The address starts with https, and Chrome shows "Connection is secure".

Title: Checkout page uses a secure HTTPS connection
Preconditions: 1. The user is logged in with ACC-01. 2. The cart contains Men Tshirt (Quantity 1). 3. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Steps: 1. Click Cart in the header. 2. Click Proceed To Checkout. 3. Click the icon to the left of the web address in Chrome.
Expected Result: The address starts with https, and Chrome shows "Connection is secure".

Title: End-to-end purchase works in Safari
Preconditions: 1. The user is logged in with ACC-01 in Safari. 2. The cart is empty. 3. The Home page is open in Safari.
Test Data: Product: PROD-02 (Men Tshirt, Rs. 400) / Quantity: 1 / Payment: PAY-VALID
Steps: Follow the steps of TC-CHK-17 in Safari: 1. On the Home page, click Add to cart under Men Tshirt. 2. Click View Cart in the pop-up. 3. Click Proceed To Checkout. 4. Click Place Order. 5. Fill in all payment fields using PAY-VALID. 6. Click Pay and Confirm Order. 7. Click Download Invoice. 8. Open invoice.txt.
Expected Result: All checkpoints of TC-CHK-17 pass in Safari: Men Tshirt in the cart with Total Rs. 400; Total Amount Rs. 400 at checkout; the "Order Placed!" page appears; the invoice shows "Lara QA" and 400.
Comments: Compatibility test reusing TC-CHK-17. Record the Safari version used.

Title: End-to-end purchase works at mobile width (375 px)
Preconditions: 1. The user is logged in with ACC-01 in Chrome. 2. The cart is empty. 3. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Test Data: Product: PROD-02 (Men Tshirt, Rs. 400) / Quantity: 1 / Payment: PAY-VALID / Screen width: 375 px
Steps: 1. Press Cmd + Option + I to open Developer Tools. 2. Press Cmd + Shift + M to turn on device mode. 3. At the top of the page, set the width to 375. 4. Reload the page. 5. Follow steps 1–8 of TC-CHK-17 (use the mobile menu if header links are hidden).
Expected Result: All checkpoints of TC-CHK-17 pass. All text and buttons are visible and clickable without horizontal scrolling.
Comments: Compatibility test reusing TC-CHK-17. Device emulation is not a real phone; note this in results.

Title: First-time user can complete a purchase within 5 minutes
Preconditions: 1. A volunteer who has never used the site is available. 2. The volunteer is logged in with ACC-01. 3. The cart is empty. 4. The Home page is open in Chrome.
Test Data: Task for the volunteer: "Buy one Men Tshirt." / Payment: PAY-VALID (given on paper)
Steps: 1. Give the volunteer the task and the payment details, with no other instructions. 2. Start a timer. 3. Watch without helping. 4. Stop the timer when the "Order Placed!" page appears. 5. Record the time and any moments where the volunteer hesitated or got confused.
Expected Result: The volunteer places the order within 5 minutes without asking for help.
Comments: Requires a volunteer (e.g., a friend). Their confusion points are useful usability observations even if the test passes.
